rv.q: Incredible… so polished, it defies belief.
At the finale everyone was clapping and singing along and I left humming happily.
The book, music and lyrics may not be hugely sophisticated but the choruses are catchy.

In many ways, it was atrocious, incoherent nonsense. But that's what's so funny, really, watching them muddle through the ludicrous task set for them, occasionally absolutely flooring you with a song pastiche so perfect it's no wonder the programme has a section devoted to conspiracy theories about it all being a set-up.
The seemingly effortless synergy between the performers is what makes this so appealing.

cn.t: The Olivier Award-winning improv troupe continues to impress with their spontaneous musical creation, demonstrating the enduring strength of theatrical improvisation despite recent losses in the improv community.
